name: AIRBTC_exp
fix_description: Function 0x008ea502 takes (recordId, amount, recipient) and transfers contract-held tokens. It does not validate that msg.sender is the owner of the record (arg0). Anyone can pass any recordId and withdraw other users escrowed funds. Fix: add require(records[arg0].owner == msg.sender).
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, direct exploit: it reads the vulnerable contract’s token balance, invokes a single arbitrary/unsafe call on the target to transfer out funds, then swaps the stolen tokens on PancakeSwap. It requires little protocol-specific reasoning beyond recognizing a missing access control/arbitrary call pattern and uses only a couple of external interactions.
